blind.description: An open book lying flat on the ground. It features a reddish-brown leather or cloth cover with small decorative gold/yellow dots along the outer borders, thick cream-coloured pages with subtle horizontal line markings, and a green ribbon bookmark running down the center spine.
blind.from_above: A neat rectangular shape formed by two cream-coloured pages side by side, divided vertically by a dark green ribbon bookmark, with the reddish cover trim slightly visible around the perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely flat, only a few inches high off the floor (under 1/20 of the figure's height), with a width of approximately 1.5 feet (around 1/4 of the figure's height).
